sloka: शान्तरश्मिरिवादित्यो निर्वाण इव पावकः।स बभूव महातेजा व्यपास्तगतजीवितः ।। ६.९१.८५ ।।
transliteration: śāntaraśmirivādityo nirvāṇa iva pāvakaḥ।sa babhūva mahātejā vyapāstagatajīvitaḥ ।। 6.91.85 ।।

translations.english: Shorn of life, the broad shouldered Indrajith remained on the ground like the Sun whose rays have become cool, after death.
